name: Upward-Flowing Staircase Waterfall
description: A surreal stone staircase where water flows upward into a glowing sky.
prompt: A single surreal landscape: an ancient stone staircase climbing into a dreamy sky, sparkling water flowing upward along the steps in impossible ribbons, moss and wildflowers on the edges, soft golden clouds, distant floating rocks, a lone figure gazing upward for scale, cinematic lighting, photorealistic fantasy, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: What if the waterfall was the path? 🌊🪜
